title: Thoughts on the Market: AI Productivity and Employment Resilience
executive_summary: Morgan Stanley's Global Chief Economist Seth Carpenter discusses the impact of AI on productivity and employment, citing cautious optimism due to rising output without a sharp drop in employment in exposed industries.
